item.title: What can toughen Louisiana's coast against worsening storms? 4 years and 30,000 trees
item.description: MERAUX, La. item.title: Thousands without power across Louisiana and Mississippi following overnight storms
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; Thousands of residents across Louisiana and Mississippi were left without power after storms moved across the region late Saturday night.As of 2 p.m. Sunday, nearly 6,000 customers in Louisiana remained without electricity, down from more than 8,000 earlier in the day.Damage, including fallen trees, downed power lines, and roof damage, was reported in Tangipahoa Parish and Ascension Parish. item.title: Three people killed in I-12 crash near Albany on Sunday
item.description: ALBANY &mdash; Three people were reported dead on Sunday after a two-vehicle crash on I-12 in Livingston Parish.According to officials, the crash occurred on I-12 westbound near mile marker 32 near Albany.&nbsp;Emergency responders arrived to find one of the vehicles on fire. Three people were pronounced dead on the scene.Officers with the Albany Police Department said this is the second crash they have responded to in this area this weekend. The first crash occurred on Friday.&nbsp;Permalink| C

item.title: 22-year-old killed in shooting at Sharp Lane apartment complex
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A 22-year-old was killed in a shooting at a Baton Rouge apartment complex along Sharp Lane on Sunday afternoon.&nbsp;The shooting happened around 4 p.m. at the Park East Apartments, just off of Florida Boulevard.&nbsp;The Baton Rouge Police Department said David Johnson was walking to his car in the parking lot when shots were fired.&nbsp;Johnson died at the scene. item.title: One killed, one hurt in shooting along Goodwood Boulevard
item.description: BATON ROUGE - One person was killed and another was injured in a shooting along Goodwood Boulevard on Sunday evening.&nbsp;Sources said the shooting happened around 7 p.m. along Goodwood near South Flannery Road.&nbsp;One person died at the scene and another was taken to a hospital.&nbsp;The Baton Rouge Police Department is investigating.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Who is your hero? Zachary Mardi Gras parade brings focus to the heroes in peoples lives
item.description: &nbsp;ZACHARY - The inaugural Zachary Mardi Gras parade rolled down Church Street on Sunday for a day of catching beads, good vibes, and music.The theme of the parade was "Everyday Heroes." A hero can be someone like Superman or Spider-Man, but in Zachary, a hero can be anyone."We help everyday heroes.
